subject: Q3 executive growth commitments & comp-band delegations
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 executive growth commitments & comp-band delegations

Team —

Attached is the proposed Q3 executive headcount roadmap and the companion comp-band recommendations. High level: we are planning to open 5 executive-level roles (VP+/Head) across Eng, Product, Sales and CS with staged offers across June–Aug to align with product milestones and sales cycles.

Key asks:
- Please review the attached Q3_exec_commitments.xlsx and comp_band_proposal.pdf; I highlighted the two priority VP roles that need immediate clearance (Eng VP infra, CRO deputy).
- Confirm whether the proposed comp bands (tabs B1-B4) are acceptable or whether we route an exception for location-adjusted market bands.
- Need formal sign-offs (reply-all) by EOD Tue so we can instruct Talent/Legal to draft offers and kick Workday reqs.

Notes:
- We are proposing a one-time band flexibility for the CRO deputy to allow up to 10% band stretch for exceptional candidates; finance runway depends on Marcus confirming the forecast (see link).
- Talent partner (Sara at Korn Ferry) is looped for market context.

Attachments: Q3_exec_commitments.xlsx (tabbed), comp_band_proposal.pdf

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 executive growth commitments & comp-band delegations

Irene —

Thanks, this looks sensible. A couple of quick notes after a skim of the spreadsheet:
- Product VP (Customer Experience) is currently marked P2 priority but product leadership would like to move that to P1 given launch timeline. I flagged rows 18–20.
- For the Eng VP infra ask: can we gate the offer on a two-week post-accept background/legal review (we've had one candidate slow on security signoff in the past)?

If we move the Product VP to P1, we should re-allocate one of the June headcount slots — happy to take on coordinating the candidate panel.

-Marissa

Irene / Marissa —

This is detailed and reasonable. Two points from Finance perspective:
1) We need Marcus to confirm Q3 runway impact before we commit to the 5 hires. If the revenue plan holds, we can do the staged approach; if not, we should prioritize Product and CRO deputy.
2) For the proposed 10% band stretch on the CRO deputy, we should tie any stretch to specific performance milestones and a clawback/bonus deferral schedule. Legal and comp teams should draft the language.

Marcus — can you confirm runway and whether you can absorb the incremental comp spend (approx +$1.2M annualized at midpoint) within the current Q3 forecast?

-Aditya

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 executive growth commitments & comp-band delegations

Team —

I reviewed the numbers. Short answer: we can fund the 5 hires in a staged cadence but with two conditions: (1) we approve only 3 for immediate budget release (June/July) and gate the remaining 2 on the mid-Q3 revenue check-in; (2) any band-stretch beyond published bands requires an exceptions form + exec signoff (I attached a simple matrix).

Concessions: I will approve the CRO deputy band stretch up to 10% if the candidate has proven quota/ops experience and we implement a 12-month bonus deferral tying 50% of the variable comp to H2 targets.

Action items I will take:
- Mark finance-approved lines in Q3_exec_commitments.xlsx and return final numbers by Wed 4/7 EOD.
- I attached band_exception_matrix.csv with the approval path and recommended guardrails.

Marcus
Chief Revenue Officer (on behalf of Finance Ops)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: band_exception_matrix.csv
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sara Kornferry <sara@kornferry.com>, Anne Greenfield <anne.greenfield@greenfieldpartners.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Final sign-offs: Q3 exec commitments & next steps

All —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per Marcus's confirmation and the agreed guardrails, we have conditional sign-off to proceed with the staged plan: 3 hires released for immediate offer prep; 2 hires held pending mid-Q3 revenue check.

Next steps (owners):
- Talent (Sara/Korn Ferry) to prepare candidate outreach and confirm market comp within the approved bands (owner: Sara).
- Legal & Comp to draft offer templates with the deferred bonus language for band-stretch cases (owner: Lauren).
- HR Ops to open Workday reqs for the three approved roles and route for hiring manager approvals (owner: Irene). Link: WORKDAY-REQ-45321.
- Marcus will publish final budget cells in the shared sheet by EOD today.

I've attached the final comp_band_proposal.pdf and included Marcus's band_exception_matrix.csv in the folder. Please reply-all with one-line sign-off ("I sign off") when your team has executed their action items so I can close the loop with Talent and Legal.

Irene Choi
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comp_band_proposal.pdf, band_exception_matrix.csv
